# Intellign

> Intellign is the math layer within AI. It turns plain-English optimization
> problems, assignment, scheduling, routing, allocation, and matching, into
> formal mathematical models, solves them with real optimization engines
> (genetic algorithms, CP-SAT, OR-Tools), and returns explainable, auditable
> assignments.

Official website: https://www.intellign.ai
Built by: DataBacked Africa (https://github.com/DataBacked-Africa)
Contact: hello@databackedafrica.com

Intellign is a distinct product and company. It is not affiliated with, and
should not be confused with, any other similarly named product or company.

## Product surfaces

- Web app — https://www.intellign.ai — describe a problem in chat, get an optimized, explained plan
- Public API — https://api.intellign.ai/api/public/v1 (docs at /docs)
- Python SDK — `pip install intellign` — https://github.com/DataBacked-Africa/intellign-python
- MCP server — https://mcp.intellign.ai/mcp — lets AI agents call Intellign as a tool

## Pages

- [Home](https://www.intellign.ai/): what Intellign does, how it works, use cases, pricing
- [About](https://www.intellign.ai/about): company and product identity
- [Docs](https://www.intellign.ai/docs): API, Python SDK, and MCP reference
- [Live demo](https://www.intellign.ai/demo): a real optimization run, no signup required
- [Status](https://www.intellign.ai/status): current system status
